complexity.correctness_reason: With the price cap lifted, e.g. prices = [200, 300], best_buy starts at 100 (never an actual price) and the code returns 200 instead of the true maximum profit of 100.
complexity.notes: Hard-coding best_buy = 100 only works because the statement caps prices at 100; initializing to prices[0] or float('inf') would be correct and equally idiomatic.
complexity.summary: Single pass tracking the minimum buy price seen so far and the best profit achievable by selling at each day, returning the maximum (floored at 0 since best_profit starts at 0).
